headline: Ethereum is falling below every important line, big funds keep pulling money out, and sellers outnumber buyers, so buying now is catching a falling knife.

messages.text: I'd skip this one. Ethereum is at $2,069, below all of its important average lines. Buying now is like trying to run up a down escalator.
Over the recent stretch it fell about 10.5%, and trading in the last hour was almost 7 times normal. That looks like a big panic sell, not a calm dip.
Yes, the RSI (a speed meter, under 30 means 'fell very fast') says 26.6. But oversold can stay oversold. In a strong slide it can keep dropping.
Big US Ethereum funds lost about $272 million of investor money from Nov 2 to Nov 5, after a record 23 days in a row of money leaving. Big money is walking out the door.
Right now sellers are lining up more than buyers. The order book (the list of waiting orders) has only $0.69 of buy orders for every $1 of sell orders.

Ethereum is also losing a race against Bitcoin. News says it is weakest against Bitcoin since July. And $2,000, the round-number floor, is just 3% below with a $432M liquidation shock in the news. If it breaks, more forced selling can follow.
The nearest ceiling, the day's average price, is $2,096. That is only about $27 above us. Small reward, but a lot of risk below.

argument:
ETH/USDT is 2069.31, down 2.58% in 24h and about 8.4% below the $2,258 reported on Nov 1. On all three timeframes (5m, 15m, 1h) EMA9 is below EMA21 and price is below SMA50 and SMA200. The 1h SMA200 is 2248.46, SMA50 is 2142.42, and the 1h window change is -10.5% with volume 6.93x its 20-bar average, which is capitulation-style selling that has not yet shown a base. MACD histograms are negative on every timeframe (1h -2.86, getting more negative than the prior -1.22).

Bull will cite RSI of 26.6 (1h) and 28.5 (15m). Oversold is not a buy signal by itself in a trend; there is no higher low or reclaimed average yet. Flows are hostile: US spot ETH ETFs had 23 straight outflow days through Oct 30 (more than $1B in October), and Nov 2-5 added roughly -$271.9M (Farside via Mitrade). ETH is also reported at its weakest against BTC since July, so capital rotates away from it. Order book bid/ask is 0.69, with $1.03M bids versus $1.50M asks in the top 100 levels. Fear and Greed is 32, Fear, rising slightly from 29, so there is no capitulation extreme either.

For an intraday long, the overhead is crowded: UTC-day VWAP 2096.32, 1h SMA20 2116.72, EMA21 2113.46, then the 24h high 2151.9. The first target near VWAP is only ~27 points, about 1.3x the 1h ATR of 21.02. Any stop below the 2028.32 low is ~41 away (about 2x ATR) so reward to risk to VWAP is about 0.65:1. A break of $2,000 is where leveraged long liquidations are flagged.

evidence.claim: Price 2069.31, below SMA50 and SMA200 on 5m, 15m and 1h; 1h change -10.5%; 1h volume 6.93x average
evidence.plain: Ethereum is under every important average line and fell hard on very heavy trading.

evidence.claim: RSI14 1h 26.6, 15m 28.5, 5m 34.4; MACD histogram negative on all
evidence.plain: The speed meter says it fell very fast, but the pushes down are still getting stronger, not weaker.

evidence.claim: US spot ETH ETFs: 23 straight outflow days to Oct 30; Nov 2-5 net about -$271.9M
evidence.plain: Big investors have been pulling money out of Ethereum funds for weeks.
For each $1 of orders waiting to sell there is only 69 cents waiting to buy.

evidence.claim: AMBCrypto: ETH's $432M liquidation shock may put $2K support at risk
evidence.plain: A huge amount of leveraged bets was just wiped out, and the $2,000 floor is in doubt (headline only).

evidence.claim: ETH at its weakest against Bitcoin since July
evidence.plain: Ethereum is losing to Bitcoin, so money prefers Bitcoin right now (headline only).
The first ceiling is close, only about $27 away, and a normal 1-hour wiggle is about $21.

evidence.claim: Fear and Greed Index 32 (Fear), previous 29; perp funding +0.0026%
evidence.plain: People are scared but not at an extreme, so there is no clear panic bottom signal.

plan_flaws: No user stop or target given; a natural first target (VWAP 2096.32) is only ~27 points, about 1.3x the 1h ATR of 21.02.
A stop below the 24h low 2028.32 is ~41 points away, so reward to risk to VWAP is about 0.65:1.
5m volume is only 0.04-0.1x average now: a bounce would be on thin volume.
plan_flaws_plain: The first ceiling is only about $27 above the price, which is a small prize.
A safe exit under the day's low is about $41 away, so you risk more than you can win.
The latest short bounces have very little trading behind them, so they can fade fast.
conditions_to_reconsider: Only after ETH closes an hour back above the 1h 20-bar average near $2,117 with higher than usual volume, the order book bid/ask rises above 1, and the ETF funds stop losing money for a few days.
